scene: The rooftop skylight unfolds outward, revealing departure gates across neon transit lanes.
picture: A flat side view along a rooftop transit deck. The silver-haired boy in a mint-green hoodie and headphones stands holding his dance bag. On the far left, a moving walkway glides forward. In the centre, a river hover ferry idles above docking magnets. On the far right, a round glass karaoke lift awaits.
shown: a humming green moving walkway with handrails on the far left
a sleek hover ferry anchored with lowered gangplank in the centre
